in_hebrew.name: Basilea
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Royal, Sovereign Lady
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Basilea הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek word 'basileus', meaning 'king' or 'sovereign'. In Christian tradition, the name Basilea is used for the Queen of Heaven, the Blessed Virgin Mary.

in_greek.name: Βασιλεία
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'basileus' (βασιλεύς) meaning 'king' or 'ruler.' 'Basileia' signifies 'royalty, kingdom, sovereignty.'

in_latin.name: Basilica
in_latin.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'basileus,' 'Basilica' signifies 'royal, kingly.'
